name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
build_method: 官方考试题抽取、无效题清理、按年份切分与机器翻译人工抽检
eval_feature: 西班牙文/英文双语、按年份切分、与官方人类成绩可比
build_method_en: Official-exam extraction, invalid-item removal, chronological splitting, and human-audited machine translation
eval_feature_en: Spanish/English bilingual views, chronological splits, and comparability with official human results
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.04701v1, official repository aghie/head-qa at da54ff230ed62664ca6eebd7ccfd2b7081f2c651, and official Hugging Face dataset dvilares/head_qa at d444ead98dd50d7949703c1662c7880a5c1ea77d (dataset script version 1.1.0). HEAD-QA extracts Spanish public-health specialization examinations from 2013 onward, retains medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry, excludes radiophysics because PDF equations resist reliable parsing, and removes officially invalidated items. The pinned schema exposes name, year, category, qid, qtext, correct-answer field ra, optional image, and answers with aid and atext. Chronological splits are 2,657 train items from 2013-2014, 1,366 validation items from 2015, and 2,742 later test items, for 6,765 total. Google API translates question and answer text; 60 samples receive two bilingual adequacy scores (4.35/5 and 4.71/5) and one native-English fluency score (4/5). For Spanish, the fixed official code exposes Length, Random, Blind_n, and IR; DrQA is available only for English, which also exposes the four shared baselines. The paper baselines do not define a canonical LLM prompt or generation configuration and do not exploit referenced images. Official eval.py parses each prediction and gold line as qid plus answer ID; "-" means unanswered. It reports accuracy, macro precision/recall/F1, and POINTS with correct +3, wrong -1, and unanswered 0.
